import math
import sys

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    x = float(x)
    y = float(y)
    n = int(n)
    
    minDiff = float('inf')
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    ratio = x / y
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        candidate = round(ratio * i)
        diff = abs(candidate / i - ratio)
        
        if diff < minDiff:
            minDiff = diff
            numerator = int(candidate)
            denominator = i
    
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
